data.name: House Of Trauma
data.detailed_description:
DEMO COMING SOON!

THE DEMO FOR HOUSE OF TRAUMA IS SET TO RELEASE EARLY JULY! STAY TUNED FOR MORE UPDATES!


About the Game

You, Gabriel, have been assigned to investigate a case of abuse of a child named David. He's claimed that his family isn't normal, they have special abilities.

You unknowingly investigate, and by the time you realize David's mother is a monster, it's too late. 

Navigate through the House of Trauma, a multi floor mansion with many secrets.

Solve puzzles by unlocking doors, fixing electricity, finding keys and other items.

Evade Mom by running for your life, hiding in closets and crawling through vents, oh and pet the innocent dog while you're at it. Make sure to explore...where every turn could be your last! If she sees you, or even hears you, RUN!

This game is based off of the family in my videos, (Shooteo.)

WARNING! This game has flashing lights and jumpscares!

Mom's faster than you, stronger than you, but is she smarter? Throw objects to distract her, and make use of the vent system to get around her. There may or may not be some weapons to use against Mom as well.

There will be four difficulties: Noob, Normal, Pro, and {REDACTED} The harder difficulty you choose, the FASTER she gets!

David's an advanced AI. Once you save him, he will follow you like his life depends on it, because it does. There's multiple endings to this game. Sometimes you'll both get alive, other times...not so lucky!

House of Trauma is a first person survival horror game. You need to save David, and escape, you must escape, for not just David's sake, but for yours as well.

data.short_description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later.
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100 (or any 4-core, 8-thread CPU).
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM minimum).
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: "Targets 1080p/60 FPS at High settings."
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) or later.
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 (Standard 6-core processors).
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8GB VRAM).
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectXCompatible
  • Additional Notes: "Targets 1080p/60 FPS at High settings."
